title: CoreApiSimpleFinSync
description: Response of POST /connectors/simplefin/sync (#546), a SimpleFIN sync on request. 200 with status synced: the sync ran once and counted against the daily request budget. 409 with status refused: nothing was synced. reason daily_limit: the daily request budget is spent, and nextSyncAt is when it resets (the next local midnight). connector_unavailable: the gate holds the connector open or paused. sync_failed: the read failed; the connector's health carries the message. nextSyncAt on a synced response is the next scheduled sync.
